model: ProfiLux LED 1100/01

source.title: OASE ProfiLux LED 1100/01 data sheet v2.3 (01.09.2014)
source.note: manufacturer data sheet hosted by poolsupplyunlimited.com

notes: Page 1 text: power consumption only 23 W, 918 lumen at 11 deg beam angle (+/-2), 4000 K, 24 V DC connector with 4 m cable, IP68, stainless steel 1.4404 (AISI 316L), housing 125 x 32 mm (125 x 87 mm overall), 100,000 h life claimed, wet and dry installation, fresh/pool/sea water, DMX/RDM controllable via Underwater Switch. Page 2 table (text extraction scrambled the label/value pairing) shows 25.3 W and 0.95 A rated current, 4 kg weight and 2800 mm cable; the 23 W vs 25.3 W discrepancy is on the sheet itself (probably LED vs total input); 23 W used. No UL/ETL listing stated on the sheet. No maximum immersion depth stated.
